## Projects

<sup>(Last updated: `r Sys.time()`)</sup>

The following is a list of open source projects maintained by the Center for Forecasting and Outbreak Analytics ([CFA](https://www.cdc.gov/forecast-outbreak-analytics/index.html)) at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

```{r}
#| label: listing-repos
#| echo: false
#| cache: true
library(yaml)
source("functions.R")

repos <- list.files("repos", full.names = TRUE) |>
  lapply(yaml::read_yaml)

repos <- lapply(repos, as.data.frame) |>
  do.call(what = rbind)
```

```{r}
#| label: get-numbers
#| echo: false
#| cache: true
contrib <- lapply(repos$repository, get_contributors)

# Further stats about the repos
branches <- lapply(repos$repository, get_branches)
```

```{r}
#| label: display-repos
#| echo: false
# Generating icons
dat_icons <- sapply(contrib, function(x) {
  gen_author_icons(
    url = x$html_url, 
    avatar_url = x$avatar_url
  )
})

# Generating titles
dat_titles <- sprintf(
  '<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>',
  sprintf("https://github.com/%s", repos$repository),
  repos$title
  )

# Generating link to maintainer
dat_maintainer <- sprintf(
  '<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>',
  sprintf("https://github.com/%s", repos$contact.user),
  repos$contact.name
)

dat <- data.frame(
  Title = dat_titles,
  Maintainer = dat_maintainer,
  Contributors = dat_icons,
  `Activity (issues/branches)` = sprintf(
    paste(
      "<a href='%s' target='_blank'>%s</a>",
      "<a href='%s' target='_blank'>%s</a>",
      "<a href='%s' target='_blank'>%s</a>",
      "<a href='%s' target='_blank'>%s</a>",
      sep = "<br>"
    ),
    # Last commit
    sprintf("https://github.com/%s/commits", repos$repository),
    sprintf(
      "![last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/%s.svg)",
      repos$repository
    ),
    # Issues
    sprintf("https://github.com/%s/issues", repos$repository),
    sprintf(
      "![issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/%s.svg)",
      repos$repository
      ),
    # Pull requests
    sprintf("https://github.com/%s/branches", repos$repository),
    sprintf(
      "![branches](https://img.shields.io/github/issues-pr/%s.svg)",
      repos$repository
    ),
    # Branches
    sprintf("https://github.com/%s/branches", repos$repository),
    sprintf(
      "![branches](https://img.shields.io/badge/branches-%i-violet
)",
      sapply(branches, length)
    )
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| label: print-table
res <- knitr::kable(dat, format = "html", escape = FALSE)
cat(res)
```

## How to contribute

New repositories can be added to this list by submitting a pull request including the following information in a YAML file:

```yaml
repository: "github-username/repo-name"
title: "Title of the repository"
description: "Description of the repository"
contact:
  name: "Person name"
  user: "github-username"
```
